fischland-dar-coast-ride.title: Fischland-Darß Coast Ride
fischland-dar-coast-ride.slogan: A 136 km loop out of Ribnitz-Damgarten fuel
fischland-dar-coast-ride.story: Pine forest, Bodden water and a proper sea-air day. A 136 km loop that starts and ends near Ribnitz-Damgarten, about 2 h 21 of riding. It goes by way of Ahrenshoop coast, Prerow forest edge and Barth Bodden roads. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.

sections.advice: This Ahrenshoop coast → Prerow forest edge stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Prerow forest edge → Barth Bodden roads is the reward section in Rostock. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 32 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 9 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Pikes Peak Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3920 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

pikes-peak-highway.story: Out of Manitou Springs, one way: 28 km, roughly 28 min in the saddle. On the way it passes Crystal Reservoir and Devils Playground. The highest point is about 4,300 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

places-friso-de-los-gitanos-o-abrigo-del.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-friso-de-los-gitanos-o-abrigo-del.story: A 297 km round trip from Nerpio - roughly 5 h 07 in the saddle. On the way it passes Benizar V, Abrigo del Pozo III, Abrigo de los Cortijos and Cueva del Peliciego. The highest point is about 1,350 m. The line favours views over speed.
